description: This bar chart illustrates SimpleQA performance metrics over the course of post-training, specifically showing the percentages of “Correct”, “Not Attempted”, and “Incorrect” responses. The horizontal axis displays the categories “Base”, “SFT”, “DPO Stage 1”, and “Final”, listed in sequential order, while the vertical axis represents “Percentage Correct” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at 20-unit intervals. Each category contains a stacked bar composed of three colored segments: green for “Correct”, blue for “Not Attempted”, and light gray for “Incorrect”. For “Base”, the bar shows 6.8% “Incorrect”, 3.2% “Correct”, and 90.0% “Not Attempted”. The “SFT” category exhibits 3.7% “Incorrect”, 57.5% “Correct”, and 38.7% “Not Attempted”. “DPO Stage 1” shows 2.9% “Incorrect”, 79.8% “Correct”, and 17.4% “Not Attempted”, and “Final” depicts 3.0% “Incorrect”, 81.1% “Correct”, and 15.8% “Not Attempted”.  The bars are arranged sequentially along the horizontal axis, and each segment within the stacked bars is labeled with its corresponding percentage value. A legend indicates the color coding for each response type.
